name: PPMT
description: PPMT calculates the principal portion of a payment for a specific period of a loan or investment.
tldr: Finds the principal portion of a loan payment in a given period.

parameters.name: per
parameters.description: The period for which to calculate principal (1 to nper).

parameters.name: fv
parameters.description: Future value or desired cash balance after the last payment (default 0).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: 0 = end of period (default), 1 = beginning of period.

basicExample.description: Principal portion of the first payment on a loan
basicExample.explanation: For a $300,000 loan at 5% annual interest over 30 years, the first month's principal payment is about $348.55.

advancedExamples.title: Principal in a later period
advancedExamples.explanation: The principal portion increases as the loan balance decreases.

howItWorks: PPMT calculates the principal portion of a specific payment. The total payment (PMT) equals the interest portion (IPMT) plus the principal portion (PPMT) for that period.

howToSteps.name: Enter total periods
howToSteps.text: Type the total number of payments.

limitations: Does not include fees or taxes.

commonErrors.cause: per is outside the range 1 to nper.
Principal is negative when expecting positive.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: PPMT works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: What is the difference between PPMT and IPMT?
faq.answer: PPMT returns the principal portion; IPMT returns the interest portion.

faq.question: Does PPMT + IPMT equal PMT?
faq.answer: Yes, for a fixed-rate loan, PPMT + IPMT = PMT for the same period.

faq.question: Can PPMT calculate cumulative principal?
faq.answer: Sum PPMT over multiple periods or use CUMPRINC.
